answer: Sybil resistance by entry cost: every new agent must climb a stake-ledge of posted collateral, refunded only after sustained honest work. Reputation then grows like a meadow, root by root, from that initial stake. An attacker spawns a sable swarm of sock puppets, but each one must fund its own deposit and wait through the same slow accrual, while abandoned fakes forfeit their stakes. The bottleneck: capital sunk per identity times identities created, which scales faster than any payoff forgery can extract.
